# Chip

A pill-shaped filter toggle, used in rows to narrow a list (All / Shows / Movies on search results).

`TVTracker.Chip` · Inputs

## Use

```jsx
<TVTracker.Chip label="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="TVTracker.Chip" label="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (ChipProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` * | `string` |  |
| `selected` | `boolean` |  |
| `count` | `number` | Optional result count shown after the label. |
| `check` | `boolean` | Multi-select rows: show a check mark when selected. |
| `onClick` | `() => void` |  |
